name: Default
shortDescription: Media request and discovery manager for Jellyfin, Plex and Emby, with settings and a SQLite database on a persistent volume.

alerts.message: Open the app right after deployment to finish the setup wizard: the account you sign in with (Jellyfin, Plex or Emby) becomes the owner, so a reachable media server is required.

The setup page may warn that the /app/config volume mount was not configured properly. This is expected with a named volume: data in /app/config persists across restarts and updates, so the warning can be ignored.
